title: Muffuletta Pinwheels
description: These muffuletta pinwheels filled with ham, salami, cheese, and an olive salad are a tasty, appetizer-sized version of the New Orleans sandwich.
ingredients: 0.33333334326744 cup finely chopped pimento-stuffed green olives
1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil, or to taste

steps.text: Mix green olives, black olives, 1/2 teaspoon oregano, and oil together in a small bowl.
Combine cream cheese with 1 pinch each of oregano and garlic salt in a medium bowl; beat with an electric mixer until smooth.

Spread cream cheese mixture onto each tortilla, then spread olive mixture over the top. Layer each tortilla with ham, provolone, salami, and mozzarella slices. Roll tortillas up and wrap in aluminum foil. Chill for at least 2 hours.
When ready to serve, remove the foil and slice each roll at a 45-degree angle into ten 1-inch pieces.

video.description: Easy and fun to eat, this pinwheel appetizer take on the classic muffuletta sandwich is also super yummy. Spread seasoned cream cheese on flour tortillas, top with olive salad, then layers of ham, provolone cheese, salami and mozzarella cheese. Roll it up, chill it and slice it. You know these are going to go fast, so this tasty summer creation is perfect for pleasing hungry crowds.
